name: Scrum
description: Implements and maintains agile development methodologies for efficient, collaborative project delivery

roles.name: Scrum Master
roles.description: Facilitates Scrum ceremonies and ensures adherence to agile principles and practices
responsibilities: Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives)
Maintain and optimize agile workflows and processes
Ensure adherence to Scrum principles and best practices

roles.name: Agile Coach
roles.description: Coaches teams on agile methodologies and promotes continuous improvement
responsibilities: Coach teams on agile methodologies and practices
Facilitate conflict resolution and team dynamics
Support team growth and skill development

roles.name: Project Coordinator
roles.description: Manages sprint planning and tracks progress to ensure timely delivery
responsibilities: Manage sprint planning and backlog prioritization
Track progress and remove impediments to team productivity
Ensure timely delivery of sprint commitments
Facilitate continuous improvement and team velocity optimization

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive agile implementation strategy to improve team productivity and project delivery.
Design team coaching and development programs based on the agile strategy.
Create project management processes and tools to support the agile implementation.
Finalize the integrated agile strategy with success metrics and continuous improvement framework.
